name: lap
description: An offline-first photo manager for large local libraries
one_liner: A private photo-organizing app that runs entirely on your own computer, with no forced upload to the cloud, so your family photos stay yours.
buyer: A privacy-conscious professional or parent with tens of thousands of family photos scattered across drives who doesn't want to trust them to Google or Apple's cloud.
business_use_cases: A family that's been paying for Google Photos storage for years switches to it to organize a decade of photos on an external drive with local AI search, no subscription.
A wedding or event photographer uses it to manage and quickly search huge local shoot libraries by content without uploading client photos to any cloud service.
A privacy-focused consumer-tech reviewer or YouTuber features it as 'the Google Photos alternative that doesn't spy on you,' driving install growth.

money_ideas.idea: Sell a paid Pro tier with advanced local AI search, face-grouping, or NAS-sync features on top of the free core app.
Offer a paid 'migrate off Google Photos' concierge service that helps non-technical families export and organize their library.

steal_this: Package a simple paid guide + script bundle: 'Export everything from Google Photos and organize it in Lap this weekend,' sold to privacy-conscious families who keep meaning to leave the cloud but never get around to it.
